messages:
Sana (People Ops): Heads-up: consolidated timeline for the upcoming performance cycle is posted. Please scan and flag any calendar conflicts by EOD Wed. TL;DR: self-evals due 2026-05-09, manager reviews due 2026-05-16, calibration sessions 2026-05-20 through 05-22, final ratings locked by 2026-05-24. Doc: https://go/redwood/perf-2026-timeline :wave:

Priya (People Ops): Which form should ICs use vs managers? I keep getting questions about the right template.

Sana (People Ops): Good Q — use the following:
- ICs: `2026 Self Eval (short)` - focuses on goals, outcomes, blockers
- Managers: `Manager Review - Q2 2026` - calibration fields included
Link to forms in the timeline doc.

Marco (Eng Manager): If someone is on parental leave during the eval window, can we extend deadlines? Last cycle we offered two weeks extension.

Sana (People Ops): Yes — extensions allowed but require manager + people ops approval. Standard process (quick):
```
1) Manager fills extension request: https://go/redwood/perf-ext
2) People Ops reviews within 48 hrs
3) New deadline recorded and calendar invite updated
```
Max extension without exec sign-off is 21 days. If you expect longer, escalate to Priya.

Jules (VP Eng): For calibration panels, who should sit on them? We should ensure cross-functional representation and avoid manager echo chambers.

Sana (People Ops): Proposed default panel composition: 3 managers (from across teams) + 1 peer reviewer (senior IC) + 1 People Ops rep. If we have a high volume of reviews, we'll run parallel panels and rotate the People Ops rep. RSVP sheet is in the doc; please add your availability by Fri.

Aria (IC): Quick ask — what's a good one-sentence opener for the self-eval? I always struggle to condense impact.

Sana (People Ops): Try this pattern: one-sentence context + one metric/qualitative outcome + one line on blockers/next focus. Example:
- "Led ownership of onboarding pipeline migration, reducing average cold-start time by 42% and cutting infra costs ~8%; next focus: stabilize canary rollout to eliminate flakiness."
Keep it 2-3 short bullets total.

HRBot: Automated reminder: Self-evals due in 72 hours for employees in EMEA. Please complete: https://go/redwood/perf-2026-forms :bell:

Marco (Eng Manager): Can you drop a short calendar invite blurb we can paste into manager invites?

Sana (People Ops): Yep — use the snippet below when creating invites:

```
Subject: Redwood Performance Review - Manager Calibration
Body: Please review your direct reports' self-evals and manager notes before the calibration meeting. Bring 2-3 talking points per review (impact, growth area, recommended rating). Doc: https://go/redwood/perf-2026-timeline
Duration: 60 mins
```

Priya (People Ops): :thumbsup: I'm setting up the calendar blocks and will add the RSVP sheet. Also adding a small manager checklist to the doc (deadline tracking + extension links).

Sana (People Ops): Thanks all — if you need exceptions or have overlapping exec travel, ping me directly. I'll post a final reminder 48 hrs before self-eval close.
